description: This file defines a PHP trait named SubunitIdChainTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides a method to retrieve a chain of subunit IDs related to organizational units, utilizing other services and methods defined elsewhere. It incorporates exception handling and relies on external traits and services.

methods.name: getSubunitIdChain
methods.description: Returns the chain of subunit IDs for the current object, fetching data via the company structure service if not already cached.
